sehemu: Part III: The Prime Minister, the Cabinet and the Government
maudhui: (1) There shall be a Deputy Attorney-General who shall be appointed by the President from among persons possessing the qualifications specified in Article 59(2) and who have continuously held such qualifications for a period of not less than ten years. (2) The Deputy Attorney-General shall be the principal assistant in the discharge of the functions of the Attorney-General and shall perform such other functions as the Attorney-General may direct.
